notes.title: New Year, New News Update, New Horizons
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Ben here.
I hope your start to the new year has been as exciting as ours!

Due to quite a few things going on behind the scenes recently I thought it was important to post another update regarding progress on Refocused and things happening outside of Revita.

For one, quite a lot of progress has been made on Refocused towards the end of last year!

We got some more updated ui elements:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/0427a22703a8eaf871b19fa9e87777ad611d4737.gif[/img]

A bunch of cool new relics!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/09d041a3f66f39976edb9d5222098fc943130ffb.gif[/img]

Even more Quality of Life!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/9365610fa0619372583c7bc70f542a9943ef812a.jpg[/img]

And lastly, the game finally has a place where you can look up general statistics and also data on your previous runs =D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/6f0e1b2043ebda2b1d7526170fa40d2c18294967.gif[/img]

Now to the more important bits! As you might remember, in the last post I mentioned that even though we would return to working on Refocused, the original issues wouldn't be gone and they still aren't. Since Refocused is pretty expensive to produce in order to get it where I want it to be according to my vision, me and the team started working on a new project to keep ourselves above water. 
While I can't say too much about it yet, though you can probably expect an announcement sometime around the middle of the year, I think it's safe to say that if you enjoyed Revita, you'll probably also like our new game!

So, what does that mean for Refocused then? The short and simple answer is that the new project has become our priority while Refocused has become the "Hobby" project. However this means we'll be able to keep working on more games going forward and ALSO work on Refocused, Refocused will just take a bit longer to complete. However this still doesn't mean Refocused WILL release, as the outside factors and general circumstances mentioned in the last post still exist, but it at the very least allows us to potentially finish Refocused without having to rely on others in regards to funding and to finish it on our own terms. Should it not, I am still proud of what we as a first time team accomplished. We finished and released a big scoped Roguelite, with tons of relics, enemies and other content. With the help of the community via countless updates throughout Early Access. And speaking of community, have been able to gather one of the coolest communities around Revita!

Refocused will never and was never meant as a way to make more money, it was a passion project through and through and will stay that way. I still have the drive to want to finish it and will continue working on it on the side.
But should the time come where I'll have to stop, so be it. I am still immensly proud of what we made and I'll keep fighting till then. =D

Of course as always, should anything change, should there be cool new details to share, or anything else I deem important to share, I'll do so here, on our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord [/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame]Twitter[/url], as transparency is always key!

Lastly I also wanted to shout out a really cool Celeste mod made by people in the community, that is based on Revita. Super cool stuff, give it a shot if you are able to =D
[url=https://gamebanana.com/mods/477632]https://gamebanana.com/mods/477632[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/4be33c093164916b4c8546cc9b9a130791a83fa5.jpg[/img]

With all that out of the way, I hope you too will have a happy 2024, me and the team certainly hope it won't be as much of an emotional rollercoaster as last year. And we hope you are looking forward what we have been cooking, be it regarding Refocused and/or the new project <3

notes.title: Dev Update | Progression Changes
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

There is a lot of stuff going on behind the scenes atm, so I might have been a bit more quiet recently.
Not just is Revita going to be at Bitsummit in Japan and at Gamescom in Germany, but there are also a handful other things, that I can't talk about right now, but might be able to one day. =D

However that won't stop me from talking about some new things I have been working on recently.
Namely, Progression Changes.

[b]The Memoria Tree:[/b]

As you already know, the tree at Memoria Station keeps track of all of your discovered secrets, but going forward it won't start out as big. As you uncover more secrets it will slowly grow more and more.
This doesn't change a whole lot in regards to gameplay, but I thought would be a cute way to have some more "visible" progression throughout the game! =D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/9255913a525b6f576de0a3dbd0576b124096ee87.png[/img]

[b]Trial Tickets:[/b]

Trial Tickets are the replacement for the previous Trial Relics. They are a little bit different from other Tickets in that they will persist between runs as long as you don't use them, meaning you don't have to slowly unlock relics in fear of not utilizing them all properly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ddb18fce42ce6c7b497fde1a82a3e010fe298746.png[/img]

[b]New Death Screen:[/b]

Lastly, we also reworked the Death Screen! Not just is it a lot clearer and faster to use now, but it also gives additional details on which Npcs got something for you at the hub, how much and what it is.
Oh and what could the "growth" bar potentially mean? Well I guess you'll have to wait and see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/8eb45d0ef67d0cc85eefc3c2445049a3eca7d0df.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/af49dc86634f2006f977fa5086118b6d2a580c0a.png[/img]


With all these changes this update is really starting to feel a lot more like a sequel than an update to be honest. but I am quite happy with the direction it is all going in and if anything they will ensure the Revita experience is a lot smoother, more fun and more interesting overall! =D
As always feel free to leave your feedback in the comments, or in the [url=discord.gg/revita]Revita Discord[/url]! 

Until next time,
- Ben

notes.title: Plushies are running out!! (also new dev sneakpeek)
notes.content:
Hey there, Ben here,

As you might have heard we are currently selling Revita Kid plushies! But that campaign is running out in pretty much 5-6 days, at which point you won't be able to buy them anymore!!
So if you want a Revita Kid plush of your own or know someone who would like one, buy one now before its too late! =D

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/lost-child-revita-kid-plush]https://www.makeship.com/products/lost-child-revita-kid-plush[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/e498851eb7473e97e9ebdf2ee906dab659a9f0e9.jpg[/img]

I have also been working on some cool Refocused stuff the last week or so, in perticular, a rework/improvement of the journal you have access to in game.
As you know, up until now, you could only access the journal when talking to the Librarian at the station, but that is changing!

Now you'll be able to open the Journal whenever you want to, once unlocked, simply by selecting its option in the pause menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/4183fa54672706467dc1e4667b5f9c52d7c20574.gif[/img]

But not just that, it has also been expanded with multiple new categories, like the new potions, locations, npcs and many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/da7bbbdd7df2755507a8234cc04600250b72c816.gif[/img]

And yes, I hear you say "But isn't that gonna make completing the journal a lot more annoying??".
Well, we are also adjusting that aspect. In Refocused you'll simply need to have seen, or collected something for its entry to count as completed. Meaning no more upgrade requirements for all the relics or defeat requirements for each enemy, in order to obtain the related secrets.

We are aware that the current version has quite a "bit" of grind towards the endgame in regards to fishing and the journal and we are aiming to address both of these as well as we can, in order to make every aspect of the game as enjoyable as possible!

Additionally, for those curious, I recently posted a list of all the things that I'd like us to accomplish with the release of Refocused this fall:

- Makeing the game/early hours even more accessible (without hurting the difficulty)
- Less endgame grind
- Less friction between run progression
- A Lot More early game variety
- Tons of new content and challenges to face

Hopefully we'll be able to pull all of those things off, it is certainly quite the challenge. =)

As always if you have feedback or questions regarding the game/update, you can always leave it either in the Steam Forums or on our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url]. I make sure to try to read as much of it as I can in order to incorporate it into Refocused's development. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/e0a45ac6e1d9144f93adacdbf053b746cb02f247.gif[/img]

Until next time o/

notes.title: Dev Update | More Reworks and Additions
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Ben here,

It is that time again. Time for another dev update!

Yes 2.0 is not dead, quite the opposite! It is bigger and better than ever!
If you are following me on [url=https://twitter.com/BenstarDEV]Twitter[/url] or are in our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url] you have probably already seen me post a lot of wip screenshots and gifs of upcoming additions, reworks, tweaks and all kinds of other stuff, but for those who haven't, I wanted to dive a little deeper into all things 2.0.

First off, while it is taking a lot longer than originally intended, 2.0 is progressing smoothly and is really turning into something worthy of the version number "2.0". With not "just" reworks and rebalances but also a ton of new content to boot. So I hope you can wait just a little longer as we are getting closer and closer to the finish line. Trust me, it will be worth it!


But lets get to the actual meat and potatoes, starting of with the [b]reworked map system[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/d50a7dbc7332e5d25b6dbe2720de72d8359567fe.gif[/img]

Not just did the map in the transition between rooms get a nice visual overhaul, it now also gives you a lot more information than previously. Aside from showing you which rooms are locked and need a key to be opened, it also shows you all the special rooms for an area [b]even [/b]if you don't have the map relic.
The thought process here being, that this will allow for more strategy and planning during runs rather than just either using a key now or hoping that you maybe get a better locked room later on.


[b]Shard Benefits:[/b]

Previously, roughly every 5 shard levels you got an additional benefit to your runs. It was always either an increase in relic rarity or the ability to equip an additional ticket for cheaper. However I always felt like that system was a little uninteresting and could have so much more potential, so 2.0 will reintroduce them as "Shard Benefits", giving you even more customizability in regards to how you want to start your runs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/24b177c19b70fd432757e2237317a58304f592ad.gif[/img]

There are a lot of them and they all give you different, minor benefits at the start of each run. Maybe you still want to start with cheaper tickets, or maybe you'd like to start a run with 3 keys instead? The choice is yours!


[b]Dyes:[/b]

Speaking of choices and customizability, Revita kid sure looks different here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/711b0b2457370b309792a4f6d8b3bb787cd22647.png[/img]

2.0 will introduce a new unlockable called [b]Dyes[/b] 
These will allow you to customize your version of Revita Kid even further! Now you can not just change your hat, but also the colours of your outfit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/d55543b7bb544560d1b058d91cefee89e082cf96.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/64b26cd620a2dbfd2f66e95a4970e2436db6961a.png[/img]

And they'll even show up on the reworked leaderboards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/608abde585a2a4048dbeb9c165e0fca255bce7e6.png[/img]



[b]Synergies:[/b]

Another big system that is getting reworked and also buffed a lot next update, are [b]Synergies[/b].

Not only does every relic belong to a synergy now instead of just a select few, but they also come in two levels, as well as being much stronger and more useful than previously!

The new Gunslinger synergy for example lets you shoot an additional bullet at 50% damage if you carry 3 relics that fit into its synergy and an additional bullet at 100% damage if you carry 5!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ffde12922da0bcc7e601d913a7018b46fd2f7f13.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/442a0d4d8d91b828f5ce6c41204a6f75a411bebd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ef0080238e2244c99b6ab639ccf6a2ad384abfba.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/f870757607ee1a0c4fbaec5fa3951b11664c1798.png[/img]

Have I mentionend yet that there will also be 25 new synergies, making it twice the amount of synergies than in 1.0?

As you can see, there is a ton of stuff happening with 2.0 and this is just the tip of the iceberg, there is so much more to it. So why not, to end things off, leave you with an additional screenshot and a gif.
Happy Holidays everyone and we'll see each other again next year!

notes.title: Revita 2.0.0 Beta Part 1 Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The time for the 2.0.0 Beta has come!
You might be asking, why 2.0.0 and not 1.1.0? Well, the update got quite big after trying to listen to pretty much every bit of feedback, be it from reviews or the community discord, to a point where a lot of major stuff got entirely overhauled (No worries it should still be just as enjoyable as before, actually, hopefully much more enjoyable!)

Additionally, yes you saw correctly, this is part 1 of the Beta! Part 1 will focus primarily on reworked mechanics, balancing, quality of life, etc, while Part 2, which will drop at some point in the near future, will focus primarily on some new content =)

Please be aware that due to this being a Beta, there might still be a handful of bugs, new things are only localized in english among a few other things, so we heavily recommend backing up your save files.
(Save files can be found in appdata/local/Revita/save_n.data with "n" being the number of the save)

To access the beta, right click the game in your steam library, go to properties, betas and then select "community_public",

Since this update changes so many fundementals about the game and we want to make sure everyone likes the changes, we encourage you to either join the [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url] to discuss said changes directly with the community and me, or leave your feedback below this post/ on the steam forums, either works. I'll be looking forward to reading your feedback! =D 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/739764a83243c4eea00409da9a25b43b9a797919.png[/img]

[list][*] [b]ADDITIONS:[/b][/list]
- More Dummies!
- The Last Refuge now has a small anvil at the beginning of the area, letting you upgrade your relics one last time
- Broken Shields can now appear as pickups, giving 0.5 Shields
- Local Save Backups
- Added remaining music tracks to the Fools playlist
- Speed chests have been added. Defeat an area quickly to get additional rewards
- Added Synergy chests. These will always give relics that are part of synergies and with a very high chance relics, that are part of synergies you have already started
- Veteran mode. Feel like the game is too easy? Set your difficulty to veteran mode at any time while in the hub.
- The Librarians Tasks. As you progress in filling out the journal, you now also get rewarded for hitting certain milestones
- Shades have been popping up around the station. The more decorated your station is, the more will appear and sometimes they even carry gifts
- New bullet mod visuals
- Added a news feed to the titlescreen, letting you stay up to date on all the important things happening in and around the game
- 1 New Secret


[list][*] [b]QUALITY OF LIFE:[/b][/list]
- Reduced the amount of time you need to stand in front of the mirror for it to activate
- You can now see if you have gotten the reward from beating a shard when selecting shards
- Synergies on relic description popups now show how many out of how many relics you need for said synergy
- Certain NPCS now have shortened dialogue after speaking to them more than once
- The tutorial got an additional room focused on being able to dash longer by pressing down the dash button
- The tutorial got some other minor adjustements
- The tutorial is now redoable at any point from the station
- Added a popup that appears when you unlocked more information for an enemy in the journal
- Made enemy attack indicators more obvious
- The ticket machine in the hub area now lets you purchase tickets much quicker
- The ticket menu now has different sorting options
- The ticket menu now lets you pick a random selection of tickets from your inventory to start with, if you don't want to choose yourself
- You can now choose whether you wanna use the visuals of a guns golden version, or the normal version
- Added a setting that shows your run score on screen at all times
- Timed platforms in the ticking towertop now have a clearer indicators as to when they turn off
- The zoom in when bosses transition into their second phase isn't as strong anymore


[list][*] [b]CHANGES:[/b][/list]
- Increased average base gun range from 70 pixels to 80
- Reworked the entire procedural enemy room generation, making for vastly more distinct and interesting rooms
- Relic chests now let you pick between two relics
- Bosses now drop Boss chests, which let you pick between multiple rewards
- Bosses are now affected by all status effects
- Miniboss are now affected by status effects, the same way bosses are
- The chain meter has been drastically overhauled, now only going up to +50% soul gain, but soul gain has been increased by default, in order to shrink the disrapency between veteran and new players
- Rebalanced Soul gain
- Removed the boss damage cap from all bosses but the final ones
- Reworked Relic Rarity system, now called "Offering Bonus" rewarding you with extra relics for spending HP on statues
- Songs selected from talking with the Fool now play throughout the entire hub area and even keep playing throughout multiple runs until turned off or changed
- Attachment doesn't take effect when collecting a key relic anymore (Specific quest related relics or mementos)
- Key relics can't be corrupted or blessed anymore
- Adjusted the chance for corrupted enemies to drop an extra soul
- Increased average burn damage
- Familiars won't start attacking until you attack
- Wall collisions of bullets aren't affected by bullet size anymore
- The second and third dial on the daily rewards now spin a lot slower
- Last Refuge now has 2 additional relic chest rooms
- The Lighting setting is back in the game but will be overwritten when getting the blinded curse, be it via curses or local customs
- While holding on to Talsiman and collecting a cursed relic will now immediatly remove the curse, without having to pick a curse (meaning you also don't lose Paladins Hammer as easily)
- Changed the Secret room indicators slightly and secret walls now have less hp
- Piercing bullets can now pierce through miniboss shields
- Looping now automatically removes key relics
- Gilded Rifts now have a legendary mimic in their statue rooms rather than a rare mimic (Now also giving a guaranteed way to get those mimics for the bestiary)
- Boss chests in a gilded rifts contain 4-5 rare relics to choose from
- Reworked how legendary relic frequency rates are treated on the backend, making legendary chests more likely to appear in later areas
- Enigma, Acceptance and Mother aren't affected by knockback anymore
- Increased the limit on the bullet cap setting
- The Hero can now appear in all areas properly, rather than just mostly in the first 2
- Prison Keys are not attached to enemies anymore but to areas instead (This might cause some relics which previously weren't unlockable to now be unlocked)
- Prison Key prices for common relics are now locked to 150 Soul coins at max
- Changed around enemy defeat requirements for the journal.
- Certain special rooms can't appear in the first area anymore.
- Shards gotten from Regret now increase your max shard by 5, allowing for more flexibility in climbing shards
- You can now choose whether or not to use your relic hammers or not
- Recycling relics will now give relic hammers depending on the relic rarity (1 per common, 2 per rare, and 3 per legendary)
- Legendary relics now only cost 1.5 max hp to upgrade on level 1
- Relic hammers needed to upgrade now increase with the max hp upgrade cost (from 1 to 4)
- Beating a shard 30 or higher run will now give you an alt hat as a reward if you have unlocked everything else from the regret fight
- Tweaked pickup chances
- While in dailies or weeklies, pickup preferences are now deactivated, meaning no matter how many keys, hp or shields you have, unless you have specific relics, their spawn chances are the same
- Updated the tutorial Enigma fight to use all of Enigmas moves after a certain point
- Crows won't fly away after picking a relic from the statue anymore
- Stat ui display isn't capped anymore
- Buffed Coin rewards from dailies and weeklies
- Changed the reward wheels in dailies. The first wheel now spins quite a bit faster, while the last one is now very slow. Additionally, all wheels have the same reward, meaning you can even get higher level rewards on earlier wheels.
- Bounty tickets now add their modifiers on top of your run, rather than replacing it, allowing you to use them on any shard or even allowing you to stack them
- Reworked the cat room, not costing a key anymore to enter and letting you choose which value to increase and which to decrease
- Adjusted the giants room to the new chest rework, now giving you a choice of 3 relics, rather than 2
- The extra special room granted by the cartographer npc now won't require a key anymore
- Observatory rooms are now unlocked as soon as you make it beyond the gazing grove, compared to being tied to a blueprint
- Challenge rooms are now unlocked by default
- Some layout changes to the hub area
- Seed system has been reworked, now only requiring 8 different inputs, as well as allowing for the letters A,B,C,D,E,F and resulting in twice the amount of possible seeds
- Golden Strings now affect relic chests directly, rather than the relic inside
- Changed how explosions work with piercing, now creating smaller explosions


[list][*] [b]FISHING:[/b][/list]
- Enemies wont drop any more bait once you have 100
- Fish now adjust their scale based on their size
- When catching a fish it will now tell you if it is the first time you caught that fish and whether its the first time you caught a shiny variant
- Rare, Legendary and Shiny fish now have visual indicators
- The chance for more rare fish to spawn increases by catching more fish in a row.
- Shiny fish now have their own colour variation and show up in the journal, to make em extra special
- Don't want to give the fisherman your fish? You can now feed the cat with them and maybe even get some special rewards?
- Added a better indicator to show how much you have charged up the fishing rod throw
- Added a pity mechanic that makes it easier to find the fish you need when you only have 1 left


[list][*] [b]GUNS:[/b][/list]
- Soul Gun: Lowered bullet spread from 10 degree to 5
- Rocket Launcher: Lowered bullet spread from 10 to 0
- Soul Gun (Buster): Charge now won't reset upon shooting and the charged up shot deals more damage and has higher range
- Soul Gun (Celestial): Decreased slash detection rate so you are less likely to get in a situation where you want to shoot an enemy but use the sword instead
- Shotgun (Base): Adjusted range downgrade to the overall range upgrade
- Shotgun (Cluster): Adjusted range downgrade to the overall range upgrade
- Charge Gun (Base): Now decreases speed when shooting, but the charge doesn't decrease by walking (Basically the same playstyle, but less tedious to play with, since you don't need to button mash directional keys to move without losing charge)

notes.title: Dev Update | New Room Generation
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Ben here,

It's been a while, so I wanted to share some updates on the upcoming update and go a bit more in depth into one of the upcoming changes, which I am especially excited for, the remade room generation.

First of, the update is still progressing smoothly, however it has gotten a lot bigger than originally anticipated, so it's taking a bit longer to develop than we thought it would. However it should still hopefully be finished sometime over the next few weeks, but no promises in that regard. I wanna make sure it's as good as it can be afterall!

Now to the more exciting topic, the reworked room generation. In case you didn't know, Revitas enemy rooms are entirely computer generated, they aren't put together by hand. The idea being, that that would make for more unique rooms and overall just more room variety. 
However, I have heard from a lot of people that they feel like the rooms are a bit too boring or repetitive. Not even requiring things like wall jumps and overall just being pretty much empty square rooms with platforms in them.

So with that out of the way, I am happy to present some examples of the entirely reworked room generation that I have been working.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/28bc107472b9bc5d9559984454a0fd2b743817c2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/0654e365a32da8522cc60b6c2b7b8e317819fc48.png[/img]

As you can see, the new system emphasizes interesting level layouts a lot more than the old one. Sometimes it even requires you to use the wall jump or gun jump to reach areas efficiently. This should make combat a lot more interesting and give you new and interesting ways to test your platforming skills, while also keeping runs overall more varied!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ec1741ef71697fa237f56825fafdb48c2faca2c2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/0cd85d1b564fdeb2b930f857a4889e9607dc615d.jpg[/img]

Hope this little preview of the new room generation system got you even more excited for the update, I certainly am. To end things off I'll leave you with a little teaser for something else coming in the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/5c3661dba6760ff730b13405af26203fa9f322d5.png[/img]

Curious isn't it? Well then, until next time!
- Ben

notes.title: Revita - What are we currently up to?
notes.content:
Hi everyone, Ben here! 

Now that things are calming down a little in regards to major crashes and bugfixes, though we are still working on remaining fixes no worries, we also started to work on incorporating some of the feedback we have received, be it via reviews, the steam forum, discord, twitter, etc. But since not everyone is following the [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame]Revita Twitter[/url], or is on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/revita]Discord[/url], I wanted to share some of the stuff we have been working on on here as well. =)

Please keep in mind, a lot of this is very much work in progress and might still change drastically till it will be made public, which will still be a good while.

First off! We heard a lot of people saying that chests, felt a bit weak compared to statues and they would like some more agency when it comes to putting together their relic build, so we are introducing chest drafting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/cc6491677613042b5d0286143294cdd7170e4f6d.jpg[/img]

Not just making chests a bit more interesting, but also giving you quite a bit more control over where your build goes.


Next up, we also heard from a lot of people that they didn't like how boss rewards and mementos were handled, or that boss rewards could be a bit more bombastic. We are listening and working on a little something :P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/79e1b4ef8d00ef39f3f9a6dbe36d977688129a4b.jpg[/img]


These are just a few of the things we are currently working on. Aside from that, we are also working on buffing a lot of the more uninteresting common relics, after a lot of people have brought up that a lot of common relics, usually simply aren't worth going for. We also have plans to update the proc gen system for the room designs in the near future, to potentially allow for faster load times and more varied and interesting room designs, but thats not set in stone yet.

Either way, I hope this has given a bit of insight into what we are currently working on and while it's probably gonna be a bit till the patch with these bigger changes will be made public, we hope you are looking forward to it! We are probably also going to have a sort of beta test once we are getting closer to release of this patch, in order to ensure that these changes are implemented smoothly and are enjoyed by the majority of people.

We can't wait to share more with you, but till then, feel free to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame]Twitter[/url] or join our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url] to be an active part in the discussion.

See you next time!
- Ben

notes.title: Revita leaves Early Access and reaches 1.0 now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

[h3]We are so excited to announce that Revita is leaving out of Early Access and has reached 1.0![/h3] 

It's been 414 days since we released the Early Access. Do you remember when you didn't know what you'd get when you were spending hearts to statues? It feels like yesterday...
4 major content updates, 14 small updates, a lot of hats and fishes, tons of fun and fatigue later, we are super proud to announce that you can now play [b]Revita 1.0! [/b] We heard there might be a discount on the game tomorrow at 7pm CEST.

[u]This 1.0 version includes:[/u]
- 80+ New Relics
- 50+ New Secrets
- 10+ New Synergies
- 30+ New Hats
- New Guns
- New Shard Modifiers
- New Lost Notes
- T̜̤̞̭̮̯͇͔͗ͮ͝h̶͖̲̫͛̃̂e̱̰͓̺͔͔̮̺͗ͧ́ ͈̦̼̖̖̪̖ͯ̉̆̕T̴̝̼͓̀r̛̹̻̙͍̙͉̬͌̓̄ű̼̲̲͕͟t͕͎ͦ̌̔́h̗̥̜̹͕̤͊͂͠ͅ

[b]And a TON more! (Like, there is so, so much) [/b]

[previewyoutube=CUlZ6dfllto;full][/previewyoutube]


[list][*][h3]GAMEPLAY CHANGES:[/h3][/list]
- Secret rooms now stay around even when taking damage
- Corrupted Rift frequency decreased heavily
- The blacksmiths apprentices can now only recycle 1 relic per area
- The blacksmiths apprentices now appear after every normal area
- Reimplemented the boss damage cap, however it is now a lot more relaxed and also scales with fire rate
- The collector now exchanges 1 common relic for 1 rare, rather than 2 common relics for 1 rare
- The map during floor transitions now also shows previously visited special rooms and all rooms in a crossroad room
- Beating shard 30 now lets you go to 75 custom shards immediatly, rather than you having to go through the custom shards 1 by 1 too, in order to unlock more shards
- Discounts in shop now reduce the price by 0.5HP rather than 1HP
- Removed the "no win" icon from the daily reward wheel
- Decreased the amount of soul coins you get from dailies and weeklies
- The Technician now lets you unlock portals even on shards you haven't beaten yet, but you can only use the portal once you have.
- Restocking a shop via a restock machine will now increase the price of using said restock machine again
- The grandma npc can now also be unlocked after unlocking at least a fourth of all hats
- Enemies that are invulnerable, can't be affected by status effects anymore (Titan Frogeyes, Alt depression, etc)
- You can now "only" hold onto 99999 Soul Coins and 99999 Materials
- Normal shops now have a lil sign attached to them that should make it more obvious as to how to steal
- Cursed shops are now also inflicted by the expensive shops shard
- You can't find the "Enforced Chain" or "Golden Chain" relics anymore, while not having the chainmeter unlocked
- The silhouette curse doesn't affect seperate segments of enemies anymore, its either the full enemy or not at all
- Hats from the gachapon machine are now distributed more evenly in rarity, rather than having all the legendary hats towards the end
- Updated shard display in the title screen
- When shooting enemies the chainmeter will now freeze for a few frames, ensuring that you can still build up your chain even if you don't have a lot of damage
- Lure chests are slightly more frequent when fishing
- Shield Turnips now only give 2 shields rather than 3
- The Priestess now lets you choose between 2 curses to remove
- Talisman now removes a random curse rather than by chronological order
- The collector now gives you choices in regards to which relics to exchange
- Soundeffects now get paused upon opening the pause menu/collection menu
- Hollow Hives now can have a curse chest in front of the boss
- Even more frogs!!
- The Connoisseur can now only spawn after the Tinkerer has been unlocked
- Added new lines of dialogue to the Connoisseur
- The Weapon room can now only be unlocked after unlocking the chainmeter
- Non enemy rooms can't be flooded in the Fungated Funnels via the area mod anymore
- Chaos runs will now always start you with a Key
- Updated Familiar AI
- Rebalanced Key drop rate
- Charmed Bullets don't get destroyed by relics, etc anymore
- Made some changes to the Enigma fight, nerfing some of its attacks
- Adjusted prison key rate
- Boss HP now scales the same way enemy HP scales in loops
- Resources now get halved with each loop
- Max HP, Max Soul and Shields now get halved with each loop
- Main stats now get halved with each loop
- Blessing rate now resets upon looping
- Relic Rarity now gets halved with each loop
- Adjusted some of the enemy journal requirements
- You can't get some curses anymore if they wouldn't affect you anyway

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/50146c6f41d80650eaf07b47efb77f4811b13442.jpg[/img]

[list][*][h3]QUALITY OF LIFE:[/h3][/list]
- New minimap in the pause menu, that lets you check what is up ahead
- Miniboss rooms now pop up on the map and the new minimap
- Changed up the default settings
- Mouse Lock doesn't affect the title screen anymore
- The game now starts you off with 1 material
- Added a tutorial window for the imprisoned

- The game now tells you on the death screen, if there is new stuff at the hub
- The Seed at the seed setting machine now is slightly transparent when not fully put in
- Relic popups now show the synergies they are a part of
- New accessibility setting that allows you to resize the cursor
- Damage indicator popups now have a different colour when hitting a boss damage cap
- New setting that lets you turn off the fog effect


[list][*][h3]GUN CHANGES:[/h3][/list]
- Machine Gun: Base damage is now 8, rather than 7
- Shotgun: Removed the damage bonus and lowered celestial weapon recharge
- Blast Gun: Increased range by 20% (originally -10% range)
- Charge Gun: Reduced range and accuracy at max charge
- Orbit Gun (Base): Decreased range multiplier by 10%
- Orbit Gun (Stationary): Decreased range multiplier by 20%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/4eef81d38ec50155d40809c69524ffbc302ac533.jpg[/img]

[list][*][h3]CELESTIAL WEAPON CHANGES:[/h3][/list]
- Grenade: Increased charge cooldown
- Bow: Increased charge cooldown
- Scythe: Increased charge cooldown
- Sword: Increased the damage from 1.5 to 2 times your damage
- Grapple: Increased speed


[list][*][h3]RELIC TWEAKS:[/h3][/list]
- Removed and added a whole bunch of relics to different synergies
- Heart Machine: Changed the effect entirely, now transforming half of your max hp into shields and giving you some shields when not having any max hp to transform
- Worn Out Glove: Now additionally grants freeze bullets, rather than increased freeze duration
- Skull Pendant: Upgrades now increase the cap (50% -> 75% -> 100%) rather than the damage bonus per curse
- Steady Foot: Can now be recycled and works as intended when doing so
- Equality: Can now be recycled and works as intended when doing so
- C.D.S: Now spawns a random big chest at the end of an area when any chest/chest room is skipped during that area.
- Pouch of Toys: Now also affects Familiars
- Watergun: New Synergies with explosion related relics
- Mementos now count as common tier relics, not rare tier relics
- Coupon and Bag of Greed now also affect the current shop


[list][*][h3]RELIC BUFFS:[/h3][/list]
- Homing Missile: Rare -> Common
- Squishy Shield: Now gives 1 HP per shield, rather than 0.5 HP
- Heart Machine: Legendary -> Rare
- Life Vest: Now has a chance to full heal you upon taking a fatal hit, rather than just negate the hit
- Pokerchip: Damage decrease changed from (-10% -> -5%)
- Fake Bill: Now also works on the rare shop, but not in cursed shops anymore
- Bag of Greed: Now also works on the rare shop
- Shopping Cart: Now also works on the rare shop
- Boxing Glove: now also upgrades damage when upgraded (10% -> 15% -> 20%)
- Laser Diode: Added a ton of new synergies
- Tiki Torch: Rare -> Common
- Shell Cluster: Buffed synergy with Moon Earring
- Dust Bunny: Lengthend the time it takes for the damage to decrease
- Orbital Flies: Increased the attack speed by 25%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/a17d3bdb5c893e85268bbb5610e14d42132899b3.jpg[/img]

[list][*][h3]RELIC NERFS:[/h3][/list]
- Silver Bullet: Rare -> Legendary
- Bouncy Ball: Common -> Rare
- Tesla Coil: Common -> Rare
- Electric Heart: Common -> Rare
- Rc: Common -> Rare
- Nail of Ice: Common -> Rare and lowered damage from (100% -> 150% -> 200%) to (100% -> 125% -> 150%)
- Titanium Armor: Doesn't give you a shield anymore when picked up
- Shield Polish: Doesn't give you a shield anymore when picked up
- Cursed Candle: Now caps at 80% bonus damage
- Idol of Fury: Now caps at 50% bonus firerate
- Converter: Now exchanges shields at a rate of (1.5->2->2.5) rather than (1.5->2->3)
- Back Shield: Rare -> Legendary
- Corrupted Chump: Now scales weaker the more curses you have, meaning you can't make it ridiculously strong by collecting like 20 curses


[list][*][h3]ENEMY CHANGES:[/h3][/list]
- Some changes to the Acceptance fight
- Some changes to the Anger fight
- Some changes to the Depression fight
- Bumble Gunner: Now doesn't scale as heavily with tricky tactics
- Non Water based enemies will now also have slowed down horizontal speed underwater as well, not just slowed down vertical speed
- Masklings and Leyeches won't be able to "attack" while charmed anymore, and beyeshops will stop protecting enemies when charmed
- Corrupted Bosses get an additional tricky tactics
- Corrupted Enemies can now get even stronger depending on how many curses you have
- the "Preyest" enemies bullets, don't home in as strongly anymore
- Buffed Commando Culteyes
- Soul Carrier Flies can now appear randomly in enemy rooms


[list][*][h3]SECRET CHANGES:[/h3][/list]
- Reassemble: Now only requires 4 relics to be recycled, rather than 5
- Recycler: Lowered the requirement of destroyed relics from 25 to 15
- Solar System: Decreased the amount of different orbitals required from 4 to 3
- Stronger Together: Increased the amount of different familiars required from 2 to 3
- Black Magic: Decreased the amount of curses required from 25 to 15
- Cleansed: Decreased the amount of curses required from 25 to 15
- Tinkerer: Increased the amount of fully upgraded relics required from 3 to 4
- Soul Collector: Increased the amount of soul required from 400 to 500
- Ceiling Crawler: Removed and replaced by a new secret

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/c7fedfae9617710fbb420819d1ec2f8343991c5a.jpg[/img]

- Clunky Chamber curse now works with lasers too

- Explosions caused by the player will now also reactivate familiars
- Fixed a crash with the pisced rod
- Bursting Bubble now works with explosions (You have been asking for this one, so this is on you)
- The "Lazyeye" relic now also gives an accuracy debuff with upgrades, as it says
- Fixed a bug with the Fool, where having custom music play in the hub and then purchasing some of his special songs, wont make them overlap anymore
- The Frozen Culteye miniboss can now still teleport after their iceblock is broken
- Minibosses don't spawn enemies slightly below platforms anymore
- Split Veyeral and Marbles don't get stuck in walls anymore

notes.title: Revita - Newsletter December 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/e7ba3b6f5d3067205793458f0bbcfadf2ac97fa5.png[/img]

[h2]Happy New Year!! ✨[/h2]

2022 is finally here, which is very good news for Revita and its release! For that occasion, we shared a [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame/status/1477339840622387202]video[/url] on Twitter. If you would like to hear what we have to say and see us -perhaps for the first time- come check it out! 

So what happened in December? 
December was the month after the last big content update, but also featured an update of its own: the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1175460/announcements/detail/3141821139288261380]Optimization Update[/url] how quaint-. Thanks to this update the game now overall runs a lot smoother and in general is a lot more optimized, [b]the game be fast now[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/f96d2166ab58fa58f0da645d7d28f3c027dc842d.png[/img]
Only a few days left to be part of [b]Revita history[/b]! The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1175460/announcements/detail/2899745676137540433]Hall of Fame[/url] event ends on Sunday 16th. If you want your hidden portrait in the game at its release,[b] it's now or never[/b]: you need to make it to the top of the Weekly Challenge... or at least ahead of the other competition that hasn't won yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/9524d24632f373c9e00c8cb264bf6253a3d3a414.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/56afedc7ceb38c1da3b5ce6fedb6d899bfcef4b6.png[/img]
In December, Revita's lead dev [url=https://twitter.com/BenstarDEV]Ben[/url] was interviewed by [url=https://twitter.com/OlexaYT]Olexa [/url]and [url=https://twitter.com/DanGheesling]Dan Gheesling[/url] on Twitch! Both shows were super fun and we received a lot of love from our community but also from theirs. Thank you all for being amazing to us and Revita! 💙

If you missed it, you can watch the VODs on Youtube :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kHRBa8_UOpE
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tfuKJQHj960

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/1f90102a03ee0bdd924c2282763dc18651652712.png[/img]

Have you noticed the grave stone in the last boss room? It was indeed related to a puzzle! It took our community roughly 2-3 weeks to solve it, but they figured it out in the end and the reward is quite something!
If you want to know the solution, take a look at this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2711294365]guide [/url] made by LordSkullington in collaboration with at least 10 people from our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url]! 

Special thanks to:
[list]
[*] LordSkullington for the Guide
[*] BlockCabin & Adam Korinek for the Translators
[*] Everyone who helped and contributed to the puzzle, you all did great! 
[*] Ben for being evil with the game
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/87cbdfb4ee2432f67f10ba97318d2cda34c10b66.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ed2fc6e057b94064e184399b529f449dfbe40cff.png[/img]
I've never really written a rhyme before.  Not in my adult life anyway. It's tricky... When Ben and I sat down to talk about the ARG and a rhyming scheme was required, it was an unexpected return to a long-forgotten skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/66b1019d02b53b3ea5bb8e441217da06a6d790b9.jpg[/img]

A new and fun challenge. 

We talked for a few hours, maybe more, then I logged off and tried to cram my brain full of rhyming couplets to get the meter right. 

The rhymes for the first draft came quickly, but the voice was wrong.  So we brainstormed some more, and before either of us really knew it, a riddle was born. I hope all of you who participated enjoyed solving it as much as we did putting it together!

Good times. Coming soon, 1.0! Are you ready?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/763850ae14e9c87cc4893df6eddffa01d6d73128.png[/img]
1.0: we're coming! 2022 is going to be our year, we hope to blow your mind with the release! 🔥

notes.title: Revita - Optimization update 0.9.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The Old Friends Update came out almost a month ago and yet here we are with the 0.9.0. Not really a big content update like the previous updates, but features big enough changes to improvements that make it worth the title. (Also lets be honest, its more fun to go from 0.9 to 1.0 than from 0.8 to 1.0)

Due to your plentiful feedback, we were able to make a ton of bugfixes, improvements and balance tweaks.

We have also worked a lot on [b]optimization[/b] the last few weeks, making it so the game now even runs on weaker systems. This is probably one of the biggest changes this update. Making the game run way smoother across the board.

And as always, if you have any bugs to report, or feedback of any sort, feel free to send it our way over at our [url=discord.gg/revita]discord[/url].

This is the last time we are writing here in 2021 (unless this update kills the game and we have to patch it, but lets hope that doesn't happen). Even though it was a rough year overall, it has been a wonderful year for Revita and we can't wait to see you in 2022. Lots of exciting things ahead! 
[h3][u]Happy holidays![/u][/h3]

notes.title: Revita - Newsletter November 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/e7ba3b6f5d3067205793458f0bbcfadf2ac97fa5.png[/img]

What happened in November? A LOT!
You might have heard that we have released the [b]Old Friends update[/b], the last update before the full release of Revita. It's been 9 months since the Early Access came out. What a journey! 

The dev team and the community achieved so much in the past few weeks. We have reached more than 200 reviews thanks to you. A lot of new players joined our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url] to share their experience with Revita and we even added some holiday goodness via a holiday patch. 
We loved seeing your reactions when you discovered the new area and encountered [REDACTED] for the first time. 
Your kind words about the game and its development mean a lot to us and we appreciate all your fanwork and feedback. From the bottom of our hearts, [b]thank you[/b]. 💙

The story is not over yet though, we still have a ways to go. But for now, let us tell you some more behind the scenes information about some of the things we kept secret over the last few months.

[u][b]Please, if you haven't beaten a full run yet, be aware that there are spoilers in this newsletter. [/b][/u]
And for your information, Revita is [b]20% off until December 13th[/b]! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/b1f616f58cedd1cccb7d7c0b19386ea1d68dedbc.png[/img]

Hi, it me, Ben.
It sure has been tricky keeping quiet about all the things we added in the last update. So many people saying "Wouldn't it be really cool if you could have multiple different starting guns?" and me nodding in silence. We added so much in the last update that I probably can't even remember everything. From area modifiers, different starting guns, completely rebalanced hp economy, to the new area and much, much more.
I really hope you are enjoying all the new additions and changes, with the entire team going all out for this update. =D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/21aa2e0112e990b4f22329c42cdb8156c45d4837.png[/img]

This update’s biggest focus for me was the underground weapon room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/56c537d360372dabdb44c0b450cb807d81965770.png[/img]

In the works for this update Ben introduced the idea for a new room in which it would be possible to switch the weapons! At first it was a small chamber but I thought it would do the weapon’s more justice if they had some room that was really symbolic, like a focus for or as it’s ‘source’ So I quickly pictured this sketch and send it to Ben who then got back to me with a updated sketch of his desired layout with the idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/7d0f415fbd9f1bc5403fd2ba8a1d6b7ceaac9dc0.png[/img]

We were really fond of the idea of subtle connections to the levels above, so hints of the metro platform above, maybe even roots from the tree that manage to find themselves all the way down. For the architecture big arches that make the room feel grand but focus the room towards the center interactables. In the end I’m really pleased of how this room turned out and with the other additions I got to do, including NPC’s like the granny and technician for which I was allowed to ask in some friends to voice act them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/d30f7c4e9ecf4df5e395345bc3872904ecee1534.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/39e0401dcf160ac02859d8683d01c59914d0ce32.png[/img]
Hey, everyone! =)

The new Revita update has recently been released and along with it a ton of new music! [url=https://disomikron.bandcamp.com/album/revita-early-access-ost]The original soundtrack[/url] is growing to a total of 45 (!!) tracks, and it's hard for me to grasp this number. Let's break down some of the new additions:

- SPOILER WARNING -

Some of you were expecting the fifth area to be Ticking Tower Top, previously only known as the tutorial area, and you were right! I composed the music for area 5 right after I had just finished working on area 2 – yes, the tune for Ticking Tower Top was actually created quite early in development. Similarly, another tune from the tutorial section makes a return: Mortis Memoria, which plays during your fight against Enigma. However, unlike the tutorial version, this one is longer, has more instruments and overall juice to it. It's one of my personal favorites from the soundtrack!

Furthermore, the Accordionist that you might have noticed in the very first reveal trailer finally makes his debut. He has his own theme called „Ballad of the Fool“ playing when you're approaching him in Memoria Station. You can listen to a lot of Revita's tunes in-game simply by talking to him. But... if you think that this is everything, I have to tell you that you're wrong. I've written many more tunes for this Fool! Have you tried sitting down next to him instead of talking to him directly? I wonder what's going to happen there...

*Announcer's voice* But wait, there's more! I've written more tunes for this update. Once you beat Enigma in an epic battle, you may think the run is over. But isn't it odd that after fighting bosses called Denial, Anger, Bargaining and Depression, the final one is called Enigma? You're right, there's something missing, and that something is called Acceptance! Unlike the previous bosses, Acceptance gets their own epic battle theme, the longest tune in the game even, clocking in at a total of 3 minutes! I'll admit that given the fact that the battle itself is hectic as heck, you might not have paid much attention to the final boss theme. If you're interested, you can listen to it as well as all the other new additions on my bandcamp. Once Revita is at 1.0, the price for the album will rise, so if you're on the fence about buying [url=https://disomikron.bandcamp.com/album/revita-early-access-ost]the original soundtrack[/url], now would be a great time to do so! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/4b3a2cb12968dacc9d959a91f9f71fb7a61020fc.png[/img]

Did you also notice that the Ending theme is a combination of both the game over theme „Nex Mortis“ and „Acceptance“? Next time you've cleared a run, take some time while you're sitting on your throne – the tune is longer than you may expect! So, that must be all new additions, right? Right?! Nope! There's more.

Remember how there's a small percentage for each area to have different background music? Yep, you guessed it, the same goes for Ticking Tower Top! And the best part about this is... ALL THE ALT SONGS ARE NOW ALSO INCLUDED ON THE ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK! \o/ Go get it xD

- Chris

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ed2fc6e057b94064e184399b529f449dfbe40cff.png[/img]

Ben and I were super excited to expand on Enigma as we approached the Old Friends update. It’s something we’ve been talking about since day one. As a character, Enigma has some of the best lines, certainly the most direct, not to take away from the charming sass-mouth of the Caretaker. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/b7f497648e5939315bb5a6385251b5bbb7fa219e.png[/img] 

Writing a villain is a different bag. Their POV has to be unique, and if possible, relatable while still implying a torrent of emotion just waiting to spill over onto everything. Maybe that emotion is cruelty or exasperation. Perhaps it’s resentment. In this case, it’s got a splash from all of the above. There’s something satisfying in that sort of meta world-weariness that we loved bringing to the game. That’s why we made sure to include some of it in the trailer. 

We’re in the endgame now, the countdown to launch, and I couldn’t be more enthused with not only what we’ve done but what’s yet to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/763850ae14e9c87cc4893df6eddffa01d6d73128.png[/img]

The plan is simple: we'll be working on 1.0. To be honest, we have already started. But everything remains secret for the moment! Hope you are looking forward to it! 

In the meantime, don't forget to participate to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1175460/view/2899745676137540432]Hall of Fame[/url]. It ends in January! 

Feel free to join our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame]Twitter[/url]. To support us and to be informed of our news, you can also wishlist Revita on Steam! 

See ya!

notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Since the "Old Friends" Update came out, we have stumbled upon quite a few bugs and crashes as is expected, but with this update we should have most to all of them fixed. Additionally we aslo wanted to adjust the balancing of certain elements, to make for an overall more enjoyable and interesting game.

If you encounter and more issues or wanna leave us some feedback, as always, feel free to join our discord [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url] and let us know! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/bfaf9f503e16987697bfc61fbeb080348440a0b0.jpg[/img]

And if you haven't purchased the game yet, [b]Revita's Early Access is 20% off! The sales end in a few hours.[/b] ✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175460/Revita/

- When backing out of the ticket menu, it will now open up the custom shard menu if your run was set to a custom shard run

- Interacting with the portal at the beginning of an area, won't deactive your hud after closing said menu anymore
- Fixed a crash when defeating an archmage culteye while its firing its laser

- Hard Hat: Actually deactivates cannons in the "Ticking Tower Top" area now
- Prism: Now works properly with lasers and rocket launcher
- The Technician now has her introduction text
- [REDACTED] death count now counts properly
- Chance machines can now appear in arcade rooms
- Brick Block: Won't break into multiple souls anymore when hit multiple times in the same step
- Fixed a visual glitch with lasers
- Trapped (Curse): Now works properly
- You are not invincible while using the pisces rod anymore
- [REDACTED] Now shoots correctly in their "clock based" attack
- If an enemy is both affected by freeze as well as slow, freeze's effect will now take priority
- Fixed a game freeze when setting wave rooms and rough rivals to max in the custom shard menu
- When unlocking the chaos ticket, your key ticket wont dissappear for a run anymore
- Hopefully fixed gamepad vibration issues when closing the game
- Secret room tune doesn't keep playing during the pause menu
- Fixed an audio bug, where the machine gun sfx would be muted after a certain enemy attacked

- Minor text fixes
- Minor visual fixes


[/list]

notes.title: Revita - 0.8.1 Update Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thanks to your feedback on the Old Friends update released yesterday, we have made a small new patch with some bugfixes for you! These should fix all the major bugs, as far as we are aware, that have been introduced with yesterdays update. Let us know if your encounter any more issues on our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url]!

In the meantine, you can [b]nominate Revita for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations/]Steam Awards[/url]![/b] It would be fun to see Revita in one of the categories! But most importantly, it can help us to get Revita more known. So if your have a moment, nominate Revita! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/9d17b53b6e588ade533e3c4c0cfc837d4b861f18.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [h3]TWEAKS:[/h3]
- Machine Gun: Minor damage and range buff
- Charge Gun: Minor range buff
- Rocket Launcher: Minor range nerf

[*] [h3]BUGFIXES:[/h3]
- HP bonuses from celestial weapons and blessings now give you the proper amount of HP
- Beating Area 5 now actually gives you the area 5 related achievements
- You don't keep the gun from dailies/weeklies anymore
- Shooting at [REDACTED] in the cutscene before the run ends while having damaged ammo or slimeball, won't crash the game anymore
- Mysterious Box: Now works on its final upgrade
- When collecting a relic, the popup now shows the correct relic for all relics again 
- [REDACTED] Bosses chain attack wont stay around anymore after being defeated
- Minibosses with the "Bullet ring" modifier now properly indicate where they shoot
- Slimeball + Moldy Cheese won't lead to infinite lifespan bullets anymore
- Laser bullets + Thermometer has been fixed and doesn't crash the game anymore
- Recycling Heart Machine won't crash the game anymore
- Memoria Station Ruins can now also be unlocked by beating the Hollow Hives
- Recycling Trashbag won't crash the game anymore
- You don't get a weird achievement popup from recycling three times and buying something from a shop anymore
- Fixed [REDACTED] and [REDACTED]'s journal entries
- Fixed Chinese localisation issues
- Star Hairpin: Now upgradable!!
- Cleansing curse won't take all of your relics anymore when gotten as a local customs curse
- Fixed an issue where pcs/laptops with dual gpu's would use the weaker gpu to run the game. This should lead to massive performance boosts for Revita running on systems like that
- The "Further beyond..." Secret now unlocks the correct relic
- Thorny Rose: Now will deal damage even if you only take shield damage
- Fixed a few audio bugs that prevented music from playing
- [REDACTED]'s Grenades can't be pushed into the ceiling anymore
- Grenadier Sentreye's grenades can now also have the accessibility outline
- Fixed the ending automatically being skipped after having seen it once
- When beating a daily/weekly, the player isn't able to walk around while invisible anymore once the leaderboard vanishes
- Additional bullets created will now also be affected by the type of gun you have (example, tormented soul with blast gun, shoots small lasers, etc)
- Fixed laser diodes range being super short
- Corrupted Chump: Now belongs to the family and corrupted item sets
- You can't give snow statues broken shields anymore
- Some achievements now don't have their description visible by default
- Traps work in boss rooms again

- minor text fixes
[/list]

notes.title: The Old Friends update is out NOW!
notes.content:
[h2][b]The Old Friends update[/b] is now available![/h2]

Here we are. Bringing you[b] the last major content update of Revita's Early Access before its Full Release[/b]. Be prepared, this is a big one! 

[h2]The Old Friends update includes:[/h2]

- Reunite with an old "friend"
- Rebalanced HP economy (Enemies deal less damage, first statue is cheaper, etc)
- New mechanic: Area Modifiers!!
- Materials: A new resource used for unlocks and upgrades at the station
- Custom Shards: Optional difficulty modifiers. How high can you climb?
- The Weapon arsenal is expanding; Unlock new starting soul guns, to mix up the gameplay
- 40+ new relics
- 15+ new secrets
- 15+ New enemies (even some older areas might have gotten more dangerous?)
- 3+ new npcs
- New celestial weapons
- New Pickups
- New Hats
And a ton more!


[previewyoutube=YXeHH5sLdGY;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget to update your reviews if your opinions on the game have changed. We have listened to a lot, A LOT of the feedback with this one in regards to the hp rebalancing and we hope, for the people who previously thought the system was too frustrating, to now be able to experience it in a way that is vastly more enjoyable!
If you have any feedback, as always, feel free to drop by our [url=discord.gg/revita][b]Discord[/b][/url]. We'd love to hear you out! Don't hesitate to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame][b]Twitter[/b][/url] too!

- Corrupted enemies are now slightly harder (slightly increased movement and attack speed, as well as 1 additional tricky tactics)

- Chest Lottery is now seeded (all hail to cheating!)

- Spiketraps now only activate after enemies have spawned rather than at the beginning of the room
- Icicles now need to be closer in the camera to activate
- Claw machines now increase in price with each use
- Claw machines now have 4-5 things in them rather than 3-4
- The Free ticket modifier for playing at a certain shard difficulty now makes a single ticket cheaper, rather than free

- Character dialogue voicelines now end when you progress through a dialogue box
- Increased ticket machine price from 10 Soul coins to 20
- Bosses don't drop prisoner keys anymore

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/83d54d873eeb6ae97879d7b7daba440494e9def6.jpg[/img]

[/list]
- Charging up "Scythe of Libra" will now increase its throwing range

- Clunky Chamber: Now has a chance to shoot a half damage bullet, rather than not shoot a bullet at all

- Enemies that are spawned by other enemies on death are now also seeded

notes.title: Revita - Newsletter October 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/e7ba3b6f5d3067205793458f0bbcfadf2ac97fa5.png[/img]
Hi everyone!

The whole team hope you had a Happy Halloween! Wait, does it mean it's already Christmas time? 😳

Like the September newsletter, we can't say too much in this one. To quote our lead dev [url=https://twitter.com/BenstarDEV]BenStar[/url]: "[i]Me looking at the beasts and bees update patchnote and going "ha cute"[/i]"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/b1f616f58cedd1cccb7d7c0b19386ea1d68dedbc.png[/img]

Heyo, Ben here.
One of the big upcoming changes, that we have already teased on twitter and discussed heavily in our discord community, is the change to hp balancing. With the upcoming update, we have taken a lot of the feedback to heart in regards to the game being frustratingly difficult. Now, difficulty isn't the issue, its supposed to be and still will be, but it should never be frustrating. In order to achieve this new balancing, enemies will now deal half a heart of damage instead of full hearts, however relic costs won't change, meaning the balancing whether you want to invest heavily into upgrades or survivability still stay the same. There are also a bunch of other changes to make, especially the early experience flow a lot better. I hope you are looking forward to those changes!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ed2fc6e057b94064e184399b529f449dfbe40cff.png[/img]

Hello again, you lovely, spooky people. It's Octoberween, and do you know what that means? It's newsletter time. The whole team has been hard at work on the next update, and as usual, any details on that front get embargoed until launch. Lucky for you, I have a few bits I saved from the last update to share. In particular, some behind-the-scenes inspiration for one of the newest characters, the Fisherman. 

When I was writing the Fisherman, I saw him in my head as death. Not in the literal sense. That's too overt. The mystery of the Clocktower and its cast of characters is far more nuanced than that. Still, he was death. Not your typical grim reaper here to spirit souls away to their final destination. Instead, he's the kindly-faced allure of giving into distraction without end. In these strange and trying pandemic times, it's easy (for me at least) to stare into the face of this ongoing health crisis, become overwhelmed, and lose myself in distractions– even if they're momentary. 

Proof that inspiration can come from anywhere, I took that notion, internalized it, and built it into the idea of the Fisherman, who wants little more from life than a quiet, sunlit day, filled with good food and, if absolutely unavoidable, tolerable conversation with a new friend. 

So, there you have it, a peek behind the Revita writing curtain.

notes.title: Revita - The Bait & Switch update is out NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[h2]The Bait & Switch update is now available![/h2]

We are super excited to announce that the third major update of Revita is live now! 

The Bait & Switch update includes:
- A new branching path, the Calm Caldarium
- Face new challenges every day/week to win fun prizes and make it to the top of the leaderboards!
- Revisit old runs by remembering and inputting their specific seed
- Visit Memoria Pond and participate in some new and relaxing activities
- Revamped Relic rarity system
- 25+ new Relics
- New Relic Synergy system
- 10+ new Secrets
- 3+ new NPCs
- new special rooms
- 2 new Celestial Weapons?
- new hats
[b]- And a ton more![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/64bbcc4b2559e956edfdb53ac0b7ffb941c3c463.jpg[/img]

If you haven't done yet, please write a review and give us your feedback on our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url]. Every comment on Revita help us to improve the game! 

[list]
[*] [h3]QUALITY OF LIFE:[/h3] [/list]
- Enemies now have indicators to show whether they'll spawn a corruption rift
- Omega and Miracle bullets now have a visual indicator, as well as a sound in the case of miracle, when they trigger
- The collection menu is now sorted chronologically with the most recent relic/curse first and in the order of Weapon, Synergy, Relic, Curse, Shard Modifier
- Added some more benefits for new players to ease them into the game better in case they are struggling

[list]
[*] [h3]GAMEPLAY:[/h3] [/list]
- Item statues now have a higher likelihood of having more interesting common relics
- Item statues now have a higher chance of having rare relics
- Item statue trades that are 3HP or above will now always be at least rare
- Shops can now carry rare and legendary relics
- Corrupted Room Relics are now at least rare
- Chests will have a higher chance for higher rarity, the further in a run you are

- Corrupted Enemies got changed entirely, they now only deal 1hp of damage, but have more complex attacks, slightly higher speed but slightly less hp than previously

- Shard modifiers got shuffled around a bit again (mainly due to the removal of the less soul and decreased max soul effects, though they can still pop up in a chaos ticket run)
- Added shard benefits to every 5th shard to spice up the runs some more

- If you win with a chaos ticket, the next chaos ticket will now be free

- New room types, small and big rooms, have been added to the room generation and make for some fun new challenges

- Mimics now have a higher chance to drop their prison keys

[list]
[*] [h3]Relic Changes:[/h3] [/list]
- Devil Pact (Relic) will now always revive you with at least 1 max hp
- Courage Trophy: Rare -> Common
- Moon Earring: Increased base range, as well as increased lifetime for bullets
- Converter: Rare -> Legendary; Now grants 3 shields on base level, instead of 2
- Angel Wing: Can now be upgraded

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/3ea92e936d6ddd0dfdb82e5acd43908493d60e2f.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [h3]Shard Changes:[/h3] [/list]
- Cheap Bosses: Now just lowers the amount of pickups dropped by bosses, rather than remove them entirely
- Enemy HP: Nerfed the effect a little

[list]
[*] [h3]Curse Changes:[/h3] [/list]
- Exorcised: Effect Nerfed
- Weakend: Now a one time damage decrease, rather than also affecting later damage ups
- Sluggish: Now a one time speed decrease, rather than also affecting later speed ups
- Sluggish: Now a one time firerate decrease, rather than also affecting later firerate ups
- Clunky Chamber: Effect Nerfed
- Necromancer: Enemies now have souls
- Parasite: Enemies now have souls
- Broken Chain: Now also decreases by .1 rather than .2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/4e623d34b80bbf9f47ca3836ea18553ac2a876f5.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [h3]Bugfixes:[/h3] [/list]
- Fixed being able to die from blacksmith upgrades for real now.
- Relic/Pickup popup doesn't stay around anymore when buying something from a shop
- Fixed Collision Bugs
- Fixed CDS crashing after not skipping a chest in the area after getting the relic
- Can't get repeat relics via shopping cart relic
- Twin souls relic won't give souls on no soul enemies anymore
- The Local Customs Modifier curse will now properly get reset after each area
- Shoppinh Cart (Relic): Now upgradable as intended
- You can get more than one relic ticket at a time again
- Golden String and Talisman can be gotten from tickets now once unlocked
- Fixed a bug that would crash the game if you have played on "one-stick" mode before the cursed choices update
- Removing Laser Diode won't give a damage up anymore
- Game won't crash anymore when making a backup, exiting the game, booting the game up again and then starting the backup save
- Explosive Bullets now scale their damage properly based on your bullet damage
- Potentially fixed the bomb grub freeze
- Can't die from ticket costs anymore


You may have seen in another news that we asked to our community to send us their best Revita clips. Here is a community trailer we made with all the cool videos we received!
 We wanted to thank you for all your support because you give us strength everyday  and everynight. We couldn't wish for anything better. 💙

[previewyoutube=yVThWQmgt7Q;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Revita - Newsletter July 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/e7ba3b6f5d3067205793458f0bbcfadf2ac97fa5.png[/img]
Hi everyone!

Here is the second [b]Revita Newsletter[/b]! We hope you'll enjoy it and as always feel free to give us any feedback you might have in the comments section! Is there anything in particular you want to know for the August one? 

In July, we had to hide many things from the community because we really want to avoid spoilers for the upcoming update. To see all the surprised reactions with each update is one of the best moments of game development, so we wouldn't want to ruin that! However, here is a small overview of what happened in July! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/2857c12e11072342aa9e71ac539cc428865cec7e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/529024b4d46464767d3ae015a9b5d81d8229da68.png[/img]
In July, we made a hat design contest on our discord! 52 players suggested their very creative design for the past two weeks. It was super nice for the dev team to see all the suggestions and debates about it! 

The winning suggestion of the Hat Design Competition is... the [b]TV based on the Gazing Grove area[/b] made by Amari! This design will be implemented into the game in the next big update! 

Thank you for your participation. You all did a great job!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/4vZrlvFD1K6r5u7ur1/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/e2a04067113dc398971f183186a569659b85ff7b.png[/img]
In case you missed it, you can now access to the Beta Branch and test the very first beta build! You'll find every detail [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1175460/view/5527589737456125682]here[/url].
If you want to, you still can give us your feedback and suggestions on our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url]! 🙏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/397787f000f2b4530758074ebb59681eb7264ec0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/b1f616f58cedd1cccb7d7c0b19386ea1d68dedbc.png[/img]

Hi, hello, Ben here!

July has been a busy, busy month. Between releasing our newest beta which drastically overhauls how relics are selected, to all the new stuff we have been working on for the upcoming [NAME PENDING] Update. :P
Some of those things we have already been teasing on our social medias!

One of the big new features coming to the next Update are the Daily and Weekly Challenges and a whole bunch of stuff surrounding them that I don't want to talk about... yet. But if you have been following our social medias you might have already figured out some of the hidden details 

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/my98Hu8lQ84RqhHj6h/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611e6bb479c3364e4ccda17fa3919de46e97d6722a4&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

We have also teased that we are trying to add more room variation into the mix by adding very small rooms among other new room generation types, so get scared. :P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/5798b8716def726546896eeed63b32989b76a220.jpg[/img]

With that all out of the way, I hope you are looking forward to whats coming soon. As we get closer and closer to the release of the next update, we'll be teasing more and more new stuff on our social media, so don't forget to follow us there if you wanna stay up to date on whats coming to the game!

Either way, it's time for me to head back to work, we got an update to finish :P


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ed2fc6e057b94064e184399b529f449dfbe40cff.png[/img]

Working on Revita is always a ton of fun. For those of you process junkies out there, Ben and I spend most of every Tuesday brainstorming and breaking story, and then I spend the rest of the week developing material. 

That material covers everything from actual in-game dialogue to the underpinning story beats that drive the Child on their journey through Revita. Often, we focus on the specifics of how we want to roll them out to you and the delivery method. Is it an NPC or a Journal entry? Who knows? Sometimes we decide to throw something into the background and hope you all see it…

I could tell you more, but the community team has instructed me to avoid spoilers at all costs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/39e0401dcf160ac02859d8683d01c59914d0ce32.png[/img]

Hey friends! 
This month, I composed quite a few new tracks for Revita, some of which were actually pretty challenging to make. For spoiler reasons I obviously can't go into detail, but let me give you some information at least, what has been going on:

One of the new songs has a live-recorded acoustic guitar in it, something I have been wanting to record and include in a tune for quite a while now! Another track has a bunch of electric guitar tracks in it and oh boy, I can't wait for you all to hear that one once the next update goes live! But perhaps the hardest challenge this month was taking a fairly old Revita tune that both you and I have listened to dozens of times by now, and completely rearranging it into a new song. I have never really done such a thing before but I hope it turned out pretty good and, once you hear it, you will go „Hey, that sounds familiar!“.

You will be able to hear the new songs, once the update drops, both in-game and as the first extension of [url=https://disomikron.bandcamp.com/album/revita-early-access-ost]the original soundtrack[/url], which will extend from 26 songs to at least 30. Thank you all so much for your huge interest not only in the game itself but also the original soundtrack. This motivates me to put even more effort into future songs! =D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/763850ae14e9c87cc4893df6eddffa01d6d73128.png[/img]

The next step is the big upcoming update. BenStar and all the artist are working hard on it! You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url]. We talk about it and we show some sneekpeaks sometimes! 
You can also follow our team on Twitter :
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/BenstarDEV]Lead Dev - BenStar[/url] 
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/SchipTimmer]Artist - Schip [/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/DisOmikronCJ]Composer - Christoph[/url] 
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/ForgedinMSpaint]Writer - Peter[/url] 
[/list]
We wanted to thank you a lot for you support. All your feedback, ideas, suggestions, comments or likes really help us and encourage us. Thank you for everything. 
See you soon!

notes.title: Revita Early Access - BETA 0.6.4 Update Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

[h2]We need you! [/h2]

It is time to introduce the Beta Branch! Our way of letting you test mechanics and features before they are put on the public branch, in order to get feedback on them and adjust things for the better!
The Beta/Experimental builds as the name might suggest aren't entirely ready for the public and can therefor be more likely to contain issues (be it technical bugs, or design ones), or have missing localisation, so if you want the most stable experience, we recommend the public branch!

However, this first beta build of update 0.6.4 brings in some major progression changes in regards to how frequently rare relics appear and other major mechanic changes, so we'd love to hear your thoughts on them!

If you want so send feedback, you can do so in the comment section here, or preferably on our lovely 
[url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url]! As always, we appreciate all the help and suggestions you are sending us! 🙏
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/1b8f130fac4533778603aeaab327bc6ef24aab4b.png[/img]
[b][h3]How to access the branch:[/h3][/b]
To access the Beta/Experimental Branch, right click Revita in your steam library, then go to [b]properties[/b] -> [b]Betas[/b] and there you enter the Beta Access Code:
"[b]AccessBetaBranch[/b]"
Which then lets you select the "[b]community_public[/b]" branch from the list.
If you would like to return to the stable builds when stable updates arrive, simply switch back to "None" in the list.



Here are the changes in the Beta 0.6.4: 
[list]
[*] [b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]
[/list]- Item statues now have a higher likelihood of having more interesting common relics
- Item statues now have a higher chance of having rare relics
- Item statue trades that are 3HP or above will now always be at least rare
- Shops can now also carry rare relics 
- Corrupted Room Relics are now at least rare
- Chests will have a higher chance for higher rarity, the further in a run you are

- Corrupted Enemies got changed entirely, now dealing 1hp of damage, but have more complex attacks, slightly higher speed and slightly less hp than previously

- Shard modifiers got shuffled around a bit again (mainly due to the removal of the less soul and decreased max soul effects, though they can still pop up in a chaos ticket run)
- Added shard benefits to every 5th shard to spice up the runs some more

- If you win with a chaos ticket, the next chaos ticket will now be free

- Added some more benefits for new players to ease them into the game better in case they are struggling

[list]
[*] [b]CURSES:[/b]
[/list]- Exorcised: Effect Nerfed
- Weakend: Now a one time damage decrease, rather than also affecting later damage ups
- Sluggish: Now a one time speed decrease, rather than also affecting later speed ups
- Sluggish: Now a one time firerate decrease, rather than also affecting later firerate ups
- Clunky Chamber: Effect Nerfed
- Necromancer: Enemies now have souls
- Parasite: Enemies now have souls
- Broken Chain: Now also decreases by .1 rather than .2

[list]
[*] [b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[/list]- Fixed being able to die from blacksmith upgrades for real now.
- Relic/Pickup popup doesn't stay around anymore when buying something from a shop
