notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/e7ba3b6f5d3067205793458f0bbcfadf2ac97fa5.png[/img]
Hi everyone! 

We wanted to share some news and behind-the-scene stuff here! We worked a lot on the Cursed Choices updates new area, NPCs, curses, relics, secrets, music, writing and... hats! In the team, we really love hats. 

This update arrived with the Steam Summer Sale. We wanted to say thank you and welcome to the new players who took advantage of it and bough the game recently! We hope you enjoy your time playing Revita! 💙

You may not know it, but the main team is composed of:
[list]
[*] Ben, lead developer
[*] Christoph, composer
[*] Schip, artist
[*] Peter, writer
[/list]
I -Gimmie, community manager- can say that is the best team in the world. This news is a good opportunity for them to say something about their work. It's time to get to know the team better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/b1f616f58cedd1cccb7d7c0b19386ea1d68dedbc.png[/img]
Hi everyone, I am Ben/BenStar, lead developer behind Revita.

As you have probably seen, we have released our second content update in june,
The "Cursed Choices" Update. I gotta be honest, the production on that update got super stressful towards the end, as we tried to cram in as much content as possible before production time ran out.
But, while we don't want to repeat that kind of situation in the future, its incredibly rewarding
to see so many people enjoy all the new content!
Watching people talk about the new features in the discord, on twitter.
Watching streams or video content by people like Olexa or Retromation, seeing them and the people in
the comments being visibly excited about Revita.
There is no better motivation than that and I am eternally grateful to anyone who decides to give the game a shot.

So thank you from the bottom of my heart!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/o5INk8pDmO1SmcRU0v/giphy.gif[/img]

We have already started working on the next content update as we speak and can't wait to show you what we have been cooking. As always we'll be teasing stuff here and there on our [url=discord.gg/revita]discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame]twitter[/url].

We might also have some cool community projects and ideas that we have been tinkering on, that you might wanna keep your eyes out for.

That is all from me now, see you next time! =D


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/39e0401dcf160ac02859d8683d01c59914d0ce32.png[/img]
The original soundtrack to Revita supplements the action-packed gameplay with a sonic soundscape ranging from somber melancholy over fast-paced electronic beats to... uh... me imitating frogs. Drawing inspiration from the works of David Wise and John Frusciante, we made the decision to have a strong focus on leitmotifs and memorable melodies.

Favorite track from the latest update: „[i]Corrupted[/i]“

Unlike all the other area tracks, which have rather common chord progressions and a predictable song structure, „[i]Corrupted[/i]“ is mostly written in a fast 7/4 time signature bursting with all sorts of dissonant chords, suitable for what's happening on-screen when this track plays.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/82abe001d3b577516d9beef15d4c888a1216183a.png[/img]

The original soundtrack is currently available for purchase on [url=https://disomikron.bandcamp.com/album/revita-early-access-ost ]Bandcamp[/url], and it will be updated along the way. So make sure to grab a copy if you have not already!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/21aa2e0112e990b4f22329c42cdb8156c45d4837.png[/img]
Hi hi! 
Through and along June I have been working the designs of a new batch of the various Characters, rooms and some touch-ups!
It hasn’t been the biggest update for me on Revita as I had to shift attention to my education for a bit, but still an abundance of fun and plenty of wonder to work with!

I’m especially very happy with the new NPC’s and their setpieces/rooms. The final product is always so exciting for me to see because I draw the sprites and pieces with the lighting and desired moods in mind and mocked up but I’m really always surprised when Ben shows me how it has turned out in the engine with light shafts and blooms. ᴸᶦᵏᵉ ᵃ ˡᶦᵗᵗˡᵉ ᵃʳᵗᶦˢᵗ'ˢ ᵍᶦᶠᵗᵎ

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/17030b0d6ad75d80c0d9010cbbe3c91bbecd7c8e.png[/img]

The touch-ups include some of the vending machine designs before they were finalised, and the new base shop! As we were going to introduce the ‘cursed’ shop I thought it was best to add more visual elements to the base shop, so that, while remaining similar I had more ‘pieces’ to play with and alter to create a more interesting contrast between the two.

If I had to pick a favorite ‘thing’ from this update would pick the Priestess NPC! I think the final design and room set piece turned out so well! Did you know our community manager Gimmie Voiced her?

You can find more of my art over on my [url=https://twitter.com/SchipTimmer]Twitter[/url] !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/ed2fc6e057b94064e184399b529f449dfbe40cff.png[/img]
For this last update, Ben and I got to dig a little deeper into the existential machinery of Revita. Everything from the new Bestiary to the Librarian and her life as an indoor adventurer. She’s one of my favorites, by the way. Between her love of crime fiction and her occasional impatience, we have a lot in common. 

Forgive me; I’ve gone off-topic.

With every new NPC, or monster, or [strike][b]redacted[/b][/strike], we’re trying to give players glimpses of the larger truths driving the Child on their journey of death and rebirth. Truths we’ve been excited to share from the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/57d8885b88988db354e0c1d71a4e21798414551d.png[/img]
[i]Here is Needle. She makes sure Peter stays on task instead of looking at gifs of cartoon hippos.[/i]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/763850ae14e9c87cc4893df6eddffa01d6d73128.png[/img]

We not even halfway through this adventure!

We're planning something exciting for the community too. It may be a sort of contest that will influence the game... It should be online next week, so we count on you to take part of it! 
To find out more when the time comes, please follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord[/url]!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BvVY40ST5LPZiHZ17g/giphy.gif[/img]

- The "Lifevest" relic now truly only triggers if an attack would kill you
- The "Wax Wings" relic doesn't let you slide on walls anymore
- You can now get cursed while flying

notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We made a quick update with some bugfixes and gameplay tweaks. Hope you'll enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/87bcc2b2a326b55f77a874af3dafe8247f5e8883.jpg[/img]


[list]
[*] Addition[/list]
- The roadmap tab on the Titlescreen is now clickable and will lead you to the update announcement.


[list]
[*] Tweaks [/list]
- Enemies that are spawned by the parasite curse, can not spawn more parasite enemies.
- Enemies that are spawned by the necromancer curse, can not spawn more necromancer enemies.
- Bosses can not be affected by the High Morale Curse anymore.
- Enemy waves in enemy rooms are not time based anymore and instead are now triggered when all other enemies are defeated.
- The amount of enemies that can spawn in challenge rooms has been lowered.
- Bargainings Spear attacks wont be able to hit you anymore, once they are stuck in the ground.
- Some of the curses got nerfed a bit, since they felt too strong.
- Minor assets adjustements.
- Minor text fixes.

[list]
[*] Bugfixes [/list]
- Fixed a crash, where if an enemy got destroyed the moment it would generate a shield from the shield curse, the game would crash.
- Fixed a crash, where the game tried to spawn spike traps, even though it couldn't.
- Fixed the third boss softlocking on other gamespeeds.
- Removed knockback on contact with spikes when in possesion of the "Spiked Boots" Relic.
- Fixed the bullet cap not working, creating infinite loops in bullets (Damaged Ammo + Lava lamp + Boomerange for example).
- Fixed Being able to spawn aquarius spears outside of a game room, resulting in a crash.
- Fixed Giants Fang/ Wind Up Key being able to give your orbital repeats.
- Fixed Heart Locket making key gates free when you have more than 1 key.
- Fixed an issue where dying to a shroomencer would not give the caretaker the correct death message and would softlock the game.
- Fixed being able to skip the forced death at the end of the currently last area.
- Fixed a bug where Medical supplies didn't show that it was on max upgrade when it should be.
- Fixed an issue in regards to non 16/9 windows, where the game would weirdly skew.
- Fixed an audio bug in regards to the infested flies, that would play multiple times on their death.
- Fixed a bug with the blacksmith, where it wouldn't show relics that would otherwise not be upgradable due to lack of resources, as upgradable, when you have a free upgrade.
- Fixed a bug, where relics from the boss key relic could get stuck in a wall.
- Fixed the 19th shard effect, not increasing shop prices as it should.
- Fixed a bug, where familiar bullets would have the enemy outlines, rather than the player ones.

Thank you again for all your feedback! 
Join our wonderful community on [url=discord.gg/revita]Discord [/url]and [url=https://twitter.com/RevitaGame]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Revita has a new publisher - and we're coming to Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38880507/c837ec280ea0f8e14ac19f80171ff404bc84fde8.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Just like we announced last week, we have several big announcements to make today!

First off: we can finally officially announce that the developer [b]BenStar is working with the publisher Dear Villagers to bring Revita to you![/b]

The second announcement is definitely the biggest here. Some of you have already been enjoying Revita’s closed alpha for a few months now, but most have yet to play the game; this is why we’re so glad to tell you that [b]Revita will soon be available in Early Access on Steam[/b]! The precise launch date will be revealed in a couple weeks, so make sure to add Revita to your wishlist to be notified!

To celebrate this, here is a brand new trailer of the game, with a handful of new things to see:

[previewyoutube=s_Dckzo4Tuk;full][/previewyoutube]

Did you see what’s new in there?

That’s right: this has been your first glance at Revita’s second area, The Fungated Funnels. This brand new mushroom infested sewer area is sure to gross you out in the best way possible, and it’s coming with new enemies, new relics to unlock and so much more!

That leads us to our third news of the day: Revita’s closed alpha receives its second major update tonight, and The Fungated Funnels will make their debut in it! Just like the last update, this is also your chance to receive an alpha key if you haven’t tried it yet: one hundred new keys will be distributed on our Discord server, which you can join here: discord.gg/revita.

Here’s a detailed changelog of the alpha update:

- The Fungated Funnels:
	Explore this new, mushroom infested, sewer area, with its own bunch of new enemies, unlocks and more!

- The Metro:
	Bringing you from one section of the tower to the next!

- The Blacksmith:
	A new Npc that can be encountered on the metro. Give him one of your relics and one of your hp containers
	and he will upgrade them for you!

- Various bugfixes and other minor changes.


We’ll talk to you again soon!
